title: Signed mapping-cocone shifts descend to the specified integral pullback
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, schemes X,Y of the recorded common universe, a morphism g:X→Y, and any normalized finite strict-tower comparison C [lem-a1-finite-pullback-strict-tower-comparison]. There exist coherent integer-shift structures c on the integral Roos pullback complex functor and d on its specified integral derived pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], satisfying the exact predicates ShiftCoordinates(c) and ShiftDescent(c,d) of [def-fd-integral-pullback-shift-coordinates]. Thus c fixes the first mapping-cocone coordinate and multiplies the second by (-1)^r under the standard finite-level product shift, and d is the shift descended through every good representative with its retained computation isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 099N(5), lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941, normalized strict-model comparison; derived.tex Tags 011G and 014E for signed integer shifts.

proof.text: Take the product of the canonical finite-level additive functor shift structures. The normalized finite chain shift in C is natural for the adjacent tower arrow, hence each quotient transition commutes with these finite shifts. Composing with a product projection shows that one minus the tower transition commutes with the product shift.

The coherent signed mapping-cocone shift now gives c and its two displayed coordinate formulas. Flat-term K-flat good complexes are stable under shifts. Restriction along the resolving good localization is fully faithful on functor categories; transport the chain shift through its computation isomorphism. The zero and addition laws are reflected by this fully faithful functor and give d. Its component equation is precisely ShiftDescent.

theorem integralPullback_signedShift
    (C : FinitePullbackStrictTower.Comparison.{u, u} l E g) :

      (d : (integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E g).CommShift ℤ),
      ShiftCoordinates l E g c ∧ ShiftDescent l E g c d
